topPRs.title: feat(proxyd): switch to InteropFilterClient (interop_checkAccessList)
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Replace op-geth's `InteropClient` (`supervisor_checkAccessList`) with the optimism monorepo's `InteropFilterClient` (`interop_checkAccessList`) from `op-service/sources`
- Bump `optimism` dependency to develop HEAD (`19a0a32fcf`) and op-geth to `v1.101702.3-rc.1`
- Migrate types to new packages: errors → `op-core/interop`, access list types → `op-core/interop/messages`, safety levels → `op-service/eth/safety`

## Context
The interop-logic-filter now exposes `interop_checkAccessList` instead of `supervisor_checkAccessList`. This aligns proxyd with that namespace change so interop validation works against the latest filter deployments.

## Test plan
- [x] `go build ./...` passes
- [x] `go vet ./...` passes
- [x] `golangci-lint run ./...` passes (0 issues)
- [ ] Integration tests pass against interop-filter with `interop_` namespace

topPRs.title: [codex] fix(proxyd): bump optimism dependencies
topPRs.author: karlfloersch
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Bumps proxyd's Optimism dependency to `v1.18.2-0.20260521143954-7657968676a2` and updates the matching op-geth replace to `v1.101702.3-rc.1`.

This also applies the mechanical access-list helper import updates required by the newer Optimism module: those helpers now live under `op-core/interop/messages` instead of `op-supervisor/supervisor/types`.

## Notes

I tried the current Optimism `develop` tip `e7c16a1fd92f999807c668a1842fbb59fbb315ee` from May 21, 2026, but Go's checksum database does not have that pseudo-version available yet. This PR uses `7657968676a209f44ed3a845cc56c52a79232032`, which includes the merged op-service interop filter client.

This PR intentionally does not change proxyd's interop RPC behavior; it is only the dependency bump plus compile-required type moves.

## Validation

- `go test . -count=1`
- `go test ./integration_tests -run TestInteropValidation_NormalFlow -count=1 -timeout=180s -v`
- `go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=10m`
- after rebasing onto latest `main`: `go test . -count=1`
- after rebasing onto latest `main`: `go test ./integration_tests -run TestInteropValidation_NormalFlow -count=1 -timeout=180s`

topPRs.title: [codex] fix proxyd interop access-list namespace
topPRs.author: karlfloersch
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Updates proxyd interop access-list validation to call `interop_checkAccessList` directly instead of using the pinned op-geth helper that still calls `supervisor_checkAccessList`.

## Why

`ethereum-optimism/optimism#20778` moved op-interop-filter's query API to the `interop` RPC namespace. Proxyd still depended on op-geth's `InteropClient`, whose `CheckAccessList` method sends the old `supervisor_checkAccessList` method.

I checked the available client libraries before making this local wrapper change: the current OP `op-service/sources.SupervisorClient` and the pinned op-geth helper both still use the legacy namespace, so a small proxyd-side RPC call is the narrowest fix.

## Validation

- `go test . -run TestPerformCheckAccessListOpUsesInteropNamespace -count=1`
- `go test ./integration_tests -run TestInteropValidation_NormalFlow -count=1 -timeout=90s`

Note: `go test ./...` reached the existing `proxyd/integration_tests` 10m timeout in a broader run; the focused interop validation flow passes when run directly.
